/-- **Covering**: `∫_{(0,1] ∩ 𝔐_{δ₀,R}} g ≤ Σ_{q, b} ∫_{J_{q,b}} g` for `g ≥ 0` continuous
`1`-periodic. -/
theorem integral_majorArcs_le {g : ℝ → ℝ} (hg : Continuous g) (hper : Function.Periodic g 1)
    (hg0 : ∀ α, 0 ≤ g α) {δ₀ R x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ₀ * R) (hw : δ₀ * R ≤ x) :
    ∫ α in Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∩ majorArcs δ₀ R x, g α ≤
      ∑ q ∈ Qset R, ∑ b ∈ Bset q, ∫ y in arc δ₀ R x q b, g y := by

proof_context.conclusion: For continuous nonnegative 1-periodic `g`, `∫_{(0,1] ∩ 𝔐} g ≤ Σ_{q∈Qset R} Σ_{b∈Bset q} ∫_{arc q b} g`, the integral over the major arcs bounded by the sum of integrals over the arcs around `b/q` (proof 90-178 periodizes each arc and uses `mem_majorArcs_iff`).
